title: Implement dashboard event bus to decouple publishing from agent loop
description:
## Problem
Dashboard publishing is currently coupled directly to the agent execution loop in AgentBackgroundService. This creates:
- Performance overhead on the agent dispatch cycle
- No buffering/batching of status updates
- Dashboard unavailability during agent restart
- No replay capability for late-connecting dashboard clients

## Solution
Implement an in-process event bus that decouples dashboard publishing from the agent loop:

1. **IEventBus interface** — Publish<T> / Subscribe<T> pattern
2. **InProcessEventBus implementation** — Channel<T>-based pub/sub with bounded capacity
3. **DashboardEventPublisher** — subscribes to relevant event types and forwards to SignalR
4. **Event types:**
   - AgentStateChanged (goal, status, inventory snapshot)
   - ActionDispatched / ActionCompleted / ActionFailed
   - ErrorEvent / WarningEvent
   - LogEvent (configurable minimum level)

## Files
- Agent.Core/Interfaces/IEventBus.cs (new)
- Agent.Core/Runtime/InProcessEventBus.cs (new)
- WebUI.Blazor/Services/DashboardEventPublisher.cs (new)
- WebUI.Blazor/AgentBackgroundService.cs (refactor — publish events instead of calling SignalR directly)

## Validation
- Dashboard updates arrive with < 500ms latency
- Agent dispatch cycle shows no measurable overhead
- Late-connecting client receives current state snapshot on connect
